Create an OpenFOAM case for the classic 2D dam-break problem using the interFoam solver.
Use a rectangular 2D domain with x from 0 to 1 m, y from 0 to 1 m, and z from 0 to 0.1 m.
Generate a structured hexahedral mesh with 200 cells in x, 200 cells in y, and 1 cell in z.
Set the front and back z-normal boundary patches to the empty type.
Place the initial water column in the bottom-left corner spanning x from 0 to 0.5 m, y from 0 to 0.5 m, and the full z extent.
In system/setFieldsDict, set alpha.water to 1 inside the box from (0 0 0) to (0.5 0.5 0.1) and to 0 outside that box.
Initialize the U field to (0 0 0) everywhere.
Initialize the p_rgh field to 0 everywhere.
Set the application to interFoam in system/controlDict.
Set the final simulation time to 1.0 s in system/controlDict.
Use the standard interFoam damBreak tutorial settings for transportProperties, fvSchemes, fvSolution, and turbulenceProperties, with the domain and mesh dimensions specified above.
